[ 79 FR 63796 , Oct. 24, 2014, as amended at 81 FR 89263 , Dec. 9, 2016; 89 FR 31931 , Apr. 25, 2024] § 98.258 Definitions. All terms used in this subpart have the same meaning given in the Clean Air Act and subpart A of this part . Subpart Z—Phosphoric Acid Production § 98.260 Definition of the source category. The phosphoric acid production source category consists of facilities with a wet-process phosphoric acid process line used to produce phosphoric acid. A wet-process phosphoric acid process line is the production unit or units identified by an individual identification number in an operating permit and/or any process unit or group of process units at a facility reacting phosphate rock from a common supply source with acid. § 98.261 Reporting threshold. You must report GHG emissions under this subpart if your facility contains a phosphoric acid production process and the facility meets the requirements of either § 98.2(a)(1) or (a)(2) . § 98.262 GHGs to report.
